method.title: How it's calculated
method.intro: Each person earns points on every social network where they're present: it counts their audience size, how much they engage with it, and how fast they're growing. The total decides their rank in their country and worldwide. The arrows show how many spots they moved up or down since yesterday.
method.why.youtube: Long-form content and search: more influence per follower
method.why.facebook: Low organic reach for its follower count

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: The ranking, profile pages, and methodology are always free. These plans are an initial proposal for creators, brands, and agencies who need more tools to work with — no plan changes anyone's score or rank.
pricing.faq1A: No. No plan, verification, or sponsorship changes a profile's score, rank, or update frequency.
pricing.faq2A: Not yet. They're an initial planning proposal and may change before commercial launch.
pricing.faq3Q: How do I join the waitlist?
pricing.faq3A: Write to us with the plan you're interested in, and we'll notify you as soon as it's available.
